1.  wrap works                           yes
2.  wrap is deferred                     yes
3.  CPR beyond last column               yes
4.  CR works at margin                   yes
5.  BS works at margin                   yes
6.  TAB wraps at margin                  no
7.  TAB cancels wrap                     no
8.  NL cancels wrap                      no
9.  NUL cancels wrap                     no
10. BEL cancels wrap                     no
11. RI cancels wrap                      no

13. SM cancels wrap                      no

18. DCH cancels wrap                     no
